reviews.text: BAYC (Bored Ape Yacht Club) is Yuga Labs’ NFT collection. Launched in 2021, it includes metaverse perks. In 2025, floor prices have stabilized. Strong community.

BAYC is a famous NFT collection by Yuga Labs: 10,000 unique “Bored Ape” profile pictures with social perks. It’s more than art, it is like a membership to an exclusive club (events on boats, DAO governance and underlying token ApeCoin that was airdropped to them). Together with CryptoPunk, it is one of the most known and traded NFT collections ever made. But while CryptoPunks are anonymous most of the time, owners of Bored Ape prefer to share their status quo. Its floor price peaked at 153 ETH in May 2022 for some apes (a 192.000% gain after minting). However, by late 2025 prices have collapsed (with around 92% down from peak) as hype has cooled and less celebrities promoted them. Since its inception and thanks to its success, Yuga Labs has launched some spin offs like Mutant Apes, Kennel Club going also toward metaverse with Otherside Metaverse, but all have similarly plummeted.

This is basically the flagship NFT collection. Personally, I see it as a cultural phenomenon. Its unique art and the community perks like exclusive access and IP rights created a huge brand. The celebrity involvement is staggering stars from Steph Curry to Snoop Dogg have proudly bought apes, which unquestionably boosted BAYC’s status. Of course, this has made the NFTs astronomically expensive. I enjoy the prestige, but I’m always aware that much of its value is hype driven; as Investopedia notes, its sky high prices are largely speculative.
Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) is a collection of 10,000 unique NFT apes on Ethereum, granting owners access to exclusive membership perks, intellectual property rights, and a strong community.
